purpose: Fail closed unless each resolved prospective-shadow row can be traced through immutable hashes from the daily endpoint source and pinned XTKS calendar to completeness and resolution receipts.
fail_closed_rules: daily endpoint manifest must itself have passed source integrity, expected_through_date, and staleness checks
pinned XTKS calendar bytes/hash used for maturity and endpoint session mapping must be recorded
selection ledger bytes/hash used for the attempt must be recorded
completeness receipt must bind the exact three upstream hashes before any resolved output write
resolved output hash must be computed after append-only/idempotent resolution and recorded in the resolution receipt
resolution receipt must bind the completeness receipt hash and resolved output hash
any hash mismatch, missing receipt, stale/truncated daily source, missing endpoint, duplicate calendar session, or invalid price blocks resolution
FAIL attempts may append an immutable failure receipt but must not mutate prior resolved history
non_goals: no production/main or production workflow changes
no reopening or rescue retune of rejected families
implementation_note: This contract freezes the provenance requirement before implementation. Existing completeness receipts currently bind normalized daily rows and sessions; follow-up implementation must bind the verified daily endpoint manifest and pinned calendar artifacts explicitly, then add resolved-output and resolution-receipt hashes without changing strategy logic or outcomes.
